slides.title: Case 2: who gets power after a fault?
slides.say: A fault removes one normal supply path. Alternative paths have limited capacity, so the operator must choose what to restore. Serving critical demand first can differ from maximizing the total power served. The agent can carry that priority into a study request, collect the result and request a new study when the situation changes.

slides.title: Multi-agent framework used in this workshop
slides.say: This is the framework implemented for the saved study. Awareness reads the case facts. Planning prepares options and uses Llama to select an allowed study. Simulation calculates the result. Verification checks the limits and whether the result matches the case. The Llama optimizer can request a small change or rank passing options. A changed trial loops back through calculation and checking. Python guards the final choice, then the operator reviews it. One Llama model fills two roles. The same framework connects different numerical tools for solar settings, restoration and suspicious readings. L10 displays its saved trace; the default Colab does not launch a live agent team.
